text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, Taiki Shuttle begged me to 
come along, so we visited a ranch for some 
fun...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-mmh! It's different from America, but 
farms really are the best!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Power is surging through me, YES! The 
smell of pasture grass, the roar of a 
tractor...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The gentle breeze blowing across the farm, 
and the echoing bellows of unruly cows...

text_block_list.name: Ranch Uncle
text_block_list.text: W-We have an emergency! The cow got loose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, several cows were escaping 
through a broken fence!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! What perfect timing! This is my cue 
to step in, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Cattle herding is our family 
business, so I'm used to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She rounded up the runaway cow from the 
outside, guiding it with her voice, and 
had it brought back in the blink of an 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That's about it, I'd say! Turns out 
I can manage quite well on my own!
choice_data_list: You've never done it alone before?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yes! Back home, I used to do this 
with Mom all the time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...M-o-r-e importantly! I feel like that 
just made my body so much lighter!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's like you WHOOSH up to top speed, and 
then make a SHARP turn, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm so glad we came to the farm! 
Thank you for bringin' me here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A few days later during training, just 
as Taiki Shuttle had said, her running had 
become remarkably sharp.
